calls.title: Prodigy + GrowthBook
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Christian Liebenow (Sales) discussed increasing Prodigy's seat count from ~90 to ~110 with Ben Johnson (CTO) and Eddy Lee (Product/Engineering) to address the pain point of restricted access to experiment results, which hindered teams despite GrowthBook being a must-have tool. They explored viewer-only licenses to keep costs flat (~$64k annually) despite pricing increases, and Eddy raised needs for pre-launch checklists and metric governance.
